meta.title: Deck of Many Colors — Personal Fan Reference
meta.subtitle: Inspired by Ninjon’s Deck of Many Colors · not affiliated
meta.disclaimer: Paint matches are approximate personal references for miniature schemes. Not official Ninjon content. Not affiliated with Monument Hobbies, The Army Painter, AK Interactive, Privateer Press, or Two Thin Coats. Always verify against your own pots under your lighting.

cards.title: Ember Knight
cards.mood: Charred plate catching the last heat of a battlefield forge.

PRO.name: Bright Gold
PRO.note: Quiet warm metal; alt matte Tan Flesh 024

cards.challenge_hint: Edge-highlight the armor only where heat would catch — leave recesses dead black.

cards.title: Verdant Witch
cards.mood: Moss cloak, poison glow, bark brown.

PRO.name: Bright Pale Green

cards.title: Frost Lich
cards.mood: Bone-cold majesty under a winter moon.
cards.challenge_hint: Keep bone warmer than the ice — temperature contrast sells the undead chill.

cards.mood: Heraldic blue, crimson cloak, gold as trim.

PRO.name: Bold Pyrrole Red + Orange
PRO.mix: ~1:1 to lift; 003 alone too dark for #EF4444

PRO.name: Rich Gold
PRO.note: Optional brighter: 028+Golden Yellow 006 ~2:1, or Bright Gold 031 alone

cards.title: Shadow Ranger
cards.mood: Dusk greens and leather, broken by one loud lantern.

PRO.name: Camo Green
PRO.note: Not Olive Flesh 041 (catalog is beige). Optional closer olive: 020+Yellow Green 065 ~2:1

cards.title: Crystal Dragon
